name: Electronic Italian dictionary with e-paper display

mentions.name: Electronic Italian dictionary with e-paper display
mentions.description: A handheld electronic dictionary built for looking up Italian words, using an e-paper display, a snapdome keyboard, and an ESP32 running Lisp. It was made as a dedicated alternative to using a phone for dictionary lookups.
mentions.problem: The author's sister wanted something to look up words in Italian that wasn't her phone, since a phone carries distractions and other apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an electronic dictionary for my sister. She wanted something to look words up in Italian that wasn't her phone, and well I like a project. E-paper display, snapdome keyboard, an ESP32 to round it out. (Runs lisp.)
